about: [O6b] A shot-out lamp's head prints black (brief O6b §2, O6's left 5): the bed, the city's own lamp at (-110.3, 14), shot by real input from across the road as O6's proof did; 3.5 s on, its cone, light and pool are out and its mouth is gone from the far tile's lights mesh (black there, that mesh printed a paper-grey disc): what is seen is the shade's own black mouth. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o6b_lamp_black.json

steps.look: (() => { const C = N.controller, e = G.camera.position, l = G.stage.lamps.all.find((l) => Math.abs(l.x + 110.3) < 0.1 && Math.abs(l.z - 14) < 0.1), h = l.head; const dx = h.x - e.x, dy = h.y - 0.1 - e.y, dz = h.z - e.z; let d = Math.atan2(-dx, -dz) - C.yaw; d = Math.atan2(Math.sin(d), Math.cos(d)); return [-d / C.sensitivity, -(Math.atan2(dy, Math.hypot(dx, dz)) - C.pitch) / C.sensitivity]; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const it = G.stage.smash.items.find((i) => i.kind === 'lamp' && Math.abs(i.x + 110.3) < 0.1 && Math.abs(i.z - 14) < 0.1), l = it.lamp; const S = G.stage.lamps, sp = S.pool.find((s) => s.lamp === l); const col = it.slots.filter((s) => s.attr === 'color').map((s) => Math.max(...s.mesh.geometry.getAttribute('color').array.slice(s.start * 3, (s.start + s.count) * 3))); window.__ld = { dark: !!it.dark, dead: l.dead, on: l.on, cone: !!(l.cone && l.cone.mesh.visible), spot: sp ? sp.spot.intensity : 0, mouth: col, hidden: it.slots.filter((s) => s.attr === 'color').every((s) => !!s.savedPos) }; return JSON.stringify(window.__ld); })()

steps.expect: (() => { const L = window.__ld; return L.dark && L.dead && !L.on && !L.cone && L.spot === 0 && L.mouth.length >= 1 && L.hidden; })()
